description:
Amsterdam’s T.NO lands on Club Djembe with a 5-track statement built for the late hours - dark, rave-ready and heavy.

The release follows his recent Yards EP on re:lax, where he balanced grime weight with baile funk fire, and his link-up with DJ Polo on Ainda, a tribal drum workout that’s been shaking dancefloors across Europe.

This EP takes that same raw energy and pushes it harder - rolling percussion, shadowy atmospheres, and basslines designed to cut straight through the rave.
